text: Planning is done. This is the first lesson where Purview's Data Map actually registers and scans Veridian's five real systems.
veridian-sql-prod, Salesforce, ORACLE_FIN, VERIDIAN_DW, and the Fabric lakehouse each register under the collection their division owns, inheriting the owner and steward assigned back in Lesson 5.

The first scans complete. Four of five sources match what we predicted. ORACLE_FIN comes back lighter on PII than expected for the source flagged as highest-risk -- no Social Security Number matches in this pass.

Four sources get their labels confirmed. ORACLE_FIN gets marked provisional instead, with a follow-up to confirm exactly what the registered scan scope actually covers -- a result that doesn't match the plan gets reviewed, not accepted.
Five sources cataloged, one flagged for follow-up. Next: turning these raw catalog entries into data products teams can actually find and trust.
